result.summary: Found 3 visible issues. The most obvious broken item is a data-formatting bug showing “€NaN delivery”. There are also some layout/clipping problems with horizontally scrolling content and the bottom navigation overlapping feed content.

issues.description: The delivery fee for “Smash Bros Burgers” displays as “€NaN delivery”, which indicates a broken price/value calculation or missing data.
issues.suggestion: Add validation and fallback handling for missing or invalid delivery-fee values, such as showing “Free delivery”, “Delivery fee unavailable”, or hiding the fee until a valid value is available.

issues.description: Several horizontal carousel items are visibly cut off at the right edge, including the category chip after “Healthy” and the third restaurant card in “Fastest near you”. While this may be intentional scrolling behavior, it looks abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel spacing, partial-card affordance, or ensure enough right padding so truncated items look intentional rather than broken.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the feed area, cutting into the second “Popular right now” card at the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards are not hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
